text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I head to the academy early in the
morning, I
spot Gold Ship outside in the
plaza.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my child. After becoming one with
the
universe while meditating last night,
my mind and
body are perfectly in sync!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Great Golshi has reached
enlightenment! I am free of all worldly
shackles! Indeed, I can even
feel... the
pulse of Gaia!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, wayward Trainer. What training
will you
have me complete today?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It matters not what you assign me. The
Great
Golshi will see it through to the
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring the affected tone she's put on,
Golshi
seems to be in peak condition.
